hostile: Chandler said Monica got hostile whenever anyone used her good scissors.

hotshot: Joey called himself a hotshot actor, then forgot the name of his own agent.

hull: Ross explained that the hull is the body of a ship, and Joey just said it was a boat.
humanitarian: Phoebe said she was a humanitarian who loved all people and most pigeons.

humility: Monica showed a rare moment of humility when Joey actually cooked something decent.

hurling: Joey was hurling insults at the TV during the game, which annoyed everyone.

hustle: Chandler said he had to hustle to reach Central Perk before Gunther locked the doors.

hypnotic: Chandler said the coffee machine's humming was hypnotic and nearly put him to sleep.

idiom: Phoebe said she loved a good idiom, then got one completely wrong on purpose.
ignite: Chandler said one bad joke could ignite an argument between Ross and Monica.
iguana: Phoebe wanted an iguana as a pet, but Monica said it would mess up the apartment.

illustration: Ross drew a careful illustration of a dinosaur and showed it to everyone proudly.
imbecile: Chandler called the rude customer at Central Perk an imbecile under his breath.
immeasurable: Monica said the value of a clean home was immeasurable, which made Joey groan.
immense: Joey felt immense pride after landing a one-line role in a tiny play.
imminent: Ross sensed his dinosaur lecture was imminent and no one could escape it.
immobilize: A single spider on the floor could immobilize Monica until someone removed it.
immune: Chandler claimed he was immune to Monica's guilt trips, then cleaned the kitchen anyway.
impactful: Phoebe said her song about pigeons was the most impactful thing she'd ever written.
impale: Joey threw a dart that nearly impaled the dartboard's frame and everyone ducked.
implausible: Ross found it implausible that Joey had never heard of a paleontologist.
impose: Monica tried to impose a strict dinner schedule on everyone and failed instantly.
imprint: Joey left a big imprint of his head on the couch cushion after napping all day.
improvise: Joey forgot his lines and decided to improvise, talking about sandwiches for two minutes.
inbreeding: Ross explained inbreeding among animals, and Chandler made a very awkward joke.
incandescent: The incandescent bulb flickered out, and Monica replaced it within seconds.
incentivize: Monica tried to incentivize Joey to do chores with cookies, and it totally worked.
incisor: Joey proudly showed off his front incisor after a visit to the dentist.
incognito: Chandler tried to go incognito with a big hat, but everyone recognized him instantly.
incursion: Ross said an incursion of pigeons had taken over the balcony of his apartment.
indicator: Rachel said a good indicator of a great outfit is that it makes you feel confident.
ineptitude: Chandler marveled at Joey's ineptitude at doing laundry without shrinking anything.
inevitable: It was inevitable that Joey would eat the last slice the moment nobody was watching.
infer: Ross could infer from the crumbs that Joey had been in the kitchen again.
infested: Monica panicked that the kitchen was infested, then found one ant and relaxed.
infiltrating: Chandler joked that Joey was infiltrating the fridge like a secret agent.
infomercial: Joey stayed up watching an infomercial and almost bought a set of miracle knives.
infuriate: Monica said it would infuriate her if anyone used her good towels on the floor.
infuse: Monica tried to infuse her tea with a fancy herb and ended up with a strange drink.
ingest: Joey managed to ingest an entire pizza without ever sitting down at the table.
inhabit: Ross said that dinosaurs once inhabited the whole planet, and Joey found that amazing.
inlet: Ross pointed at a small inlet on the map and started explaining its ancient history.
innard: Joey refused to eat the innard of anything and stuck firmly to chicken nuggets.
inquire: Rachel decided to inquire about the fashion internship, even though she was terrified.
insecurity: Chandler hid his insecurity behind a constant stream of sarcastic jokes.
instrument: Phoebe insisted her guitar was the finest instrument ever made, and she meant it.
instrumental: Monica said she was instrumental in planning the party, which everyone already knew.
intake: Ross blamed his low energy on his intake of nothing but coffee all day.
intervention: The friends staged an intervention to get Joey to stop eating off the floor.
interweave: Phoebe said she liked to interweave her songs with little stories about her life.
interwind: Chandler said his headphones always interwind into a hopeless knot in his pocket.
intolerant: Monica was intolerant of messiness and made that very clear to everyone.
introverted: Phoebe said she was a little introverted, even though she sang in public all the time.
intruder: Joey shouted that there was an intruder, but it was just Chandler coming home late.
inverse: Ross explained the inverse relationship between sleep and coffee, and Joey tuned out.
investigate: Monica decided to investigate who left her fridge open all night long.
invincible: Joey felt invincible after a callback, then lost the part the very next day.
involuntary: Chandler's involuntary laugh echoed through the quiet coffee shop at the worst moment.
irrigate: Monica set up a tiny system to irrigate her windowsill herbs, and it worked perfectly.
islet: Ross pointed to a tiny islet on the map and said he'd love to study its rocks.
ivy: Phoebe had ivy growing all over her apartment wall and thought it looked lovely.
jargon: Joey had no idea what Ross's scientific jargon meant, but he nodded along anyway.
jaundice: Ross explained jaundice to Joey, who immediately worried he might have it.
jettison: Monica threatened to jettison Joey's old pizza boxes right out the window.
jewel: Rachel held up the little jewel and declared it the perfect finishing touch for the dress.
jiggle: Joey watched the gelatin jiggle on his plate and laughed like a little kid.
jiggy: Phoebe got jiggy at a dance party in the apartment and made everyone join in.
jolt: Chandler felt a jolt of panic when Monica asked who ate her leftovers.
jonesing: Joey was jonesing for a sandwich so badly he nearly knocked over Gunther's counter.
juke: Joey tried to juke past Chandler to grab the remote and tripped over the couch.
kayaker: Phoebe said she once dated a kayaker who sang better than she did, which she doubted.
keen: Monica was keen to host the party and immediately started planning the menu.
kelp: Ross explained that kelp is a kind of large seaweed, and Joey wondered if you could eat it.
kennel: Phoebe brought home a stray dog and pretended it was from the kennel, which it wasn't.
kernel: Joey ate a whole bag of popcorn and found one unpopped kernel he couldn't crunch.
kilogram (kg.): Ross insisted on weighing everything in kilograms, and Joey asked what that was in pounds.
kneel: Ross decided to kneel dramatically when proposing, practicing in front of the mirror first.
knothole: Ross stared through a knothole in the fence and started explaining the wood grain.
knotty: Monica said the tangled string was too knotty to untie, then untied it in ten seconds.
knucklehead: Rachel affectionately called Joey a knucklehead after he mixed up everyone's coffee orders.
krill: Ross explained that a whale eats krill, and Joey said that sounded like a sad diet.
lactate: Ross explained that mammals lactate to feed their young, and Joey asked too many questions.
lagoon: Phoebe dreamed of swimming in a warm blue lagoon and wrote a song about it.
lair: Joey said the creepy basement was the perfect lair for a movie villain.
lam: Chandler told Joey to lam it to Central Perk before Monica noticed he was gone.
lament: Phoebe would lament the loss of every stray cat she met, then sing about it.
landform: Ross got excited about every landform on the map and wouldn't stop explaining them.
landlubber: Chandler called himself a total landlubber who preferred the couch to any boat.
latrine: Joey joked that the tiny bathroom looked like a latrine, which made Monica furious.
launder: Monica offered to launder everyone's clothes, then rewashed them because they weren't clean enough.
ledge: Joey crawled out onto the ledge of the apartment to get some air and immediately regretted it.
ledger: Monica kept a neat ledger of everything everyone owed her for groceries.
leeward: Ross explained the leeward side of a ship, and everyone changed the subject quickly.
legion: Chandler said a whole legion of pigeons had gathered outside the Central Perk window.
legislation: Ross jokingly proposed legislation making dinosaur talk mandatory at every dinner.
lemur: Ross said a lemur has big eyes and a long tail, and Phoebe immediately wanted one.
lenient: Monica was not lenient about her cleaning rules, not even a tiny bit.
leopard: Rachel wore a leopard print coat and called it the boldest choice of her life.
leprosy: Chandler made a terrible joke about leprosy and got a pillow thrown at him.
leverage: Rachel used her charm to leverage a better position at Ralph Lauren.
levity: Chandler tried to bring some levity to the tense dinner with a very dumb joke.
liability: Joey proved to be a liability in the kitchen when he knocked over two pans.
liable: Monica warned that anyone near her stove was liable to get scolded.
lifelong: Phoebe said her lifelong dream was to play guitar in a giant field full of cats.
ligament: Joey stretched a ligament doing a pointless stunt and limped for a whole week.
lilt: Phoebe's voice had a gentle lilt whenever she sang one of her made-up songs.
limmer: Chandler invented a word, calling Joey a limmer, and refused to explain what it meant.
lisp: Joey developed a temporary lisp before an audition and couldn't stop laughing at himself.
litre: Monica measured out exactly one litre of milk and labeled the jug with a tiny tag.
llama: Phoebe said she once carried a llama up a hill and everyone believed her instantly.
loath: Chandler was loath to admit he actually loved Monica's homemade cookies.
loaves: Monica baked six loaves of bread and organized them by size on the counter.
lockdown: There was a lockdown at the museum, so Ross had to entertain everyone with dinosaur facts.
lollygagging: Monica told Joey to stop lollygagging and actually help with the dishes.
loofah: Chandler bought a fancy loofah and Joey used it to clean the bathroom instead.
lookout: Joey kept a lookout for Monica while Chandler snuck an extra cookie from the jar.
lop: Ross tried to lop off the top of a clay dinosaur and sliced it completely in half.
lotus: Phoebe sat cross-legged like a lotus and hummed, claiming it cleared her mind.
louse: Chandler called the guy who cut in line a louse, then let him go ahead anyway.
loyalty: Monica valued loyalty above everything, unless someone touched her good plates.
lug: Joey had to lug three grocery bags up the stairs and complained the whole time.
lumpy: Chandler complained that the Central Perk couch was lumpy, but he lay down anyway.
lunatic: Monica called the driver a lunatic after he cut her off on the way to work.
lush: Phoebe said the garden was lush and green, then got distracted by a passing bird.
luxury: Rachel said having a whole drawer for her scarves was the height of luxury.
